summary: EV4 and the Problem-C design optimizer are built and pre-registered (DRAFT until the lead freezes the root), off-chain public synthetic DEVELOPMENT evidence under the owner's 2026-10-01 approval of RunPod use (hard cap USD 15, A40 at most USD 0.49/h, up to 3 pods). EV4 keeps EV2's decision rules and asks, on a 100-member panel (80 distinct MLP, DeepONet and kNN recipes) with 12 + 12 fresh conditions, whether the proposed decision-aware rule ranks real models better or worse than the deciding exam rule: a paired Kendall-tau difference with a fixed-seed bootstrap interval, UNRESOLVED unless the interval excludes zero. Problem C asks each of five rule-selected members for one two-step protocol safe across 15-35 C (the indoor range, chosen from EV2 evidence before any EV4 solve), verifies it at 90 reference conditions over 5-40 C against the baseline with the in-band points primary, and verifies each member's 50 nearest-to-limit predicted-safe points; a verified violation is an admission-condition finding. At most 1630 reference solves; nothing has run, and no testnet rule, reward or chain action changes.
